    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AboutView
    "About" page listing the project name, course, authors and technology stack.
    CsvInventoryRepository
    Stores the inventory in a CSV file so data survives application restarts.
    FontLoader
    Loads the bundled "Manrope" font files so the stylesheet can use them.
    Icons
    Simple line-art icons drawn with SVGPath, all on a 16 by 16 grid.
    InMemoryInventoryRepository
    A repository that keeps data only in memory.
    InputValidator
    Validates raw text entered by the user.
    InventoryException
    Base class for all errors raised by the inventory business logic.
    InventoryRepository
    Abstraction over where inventory data is persisted.
    InventoryService
    Business logic of the inventory: add, view, update, delete and set status.
    Item
    An item held in the store's inventory.
    ItemNotFoundException
    Thrown when an operation refers to an item id that does not exist.
    Launcher
    Plain entry point that starts MainApp.
    MainApp
    Main window of the Inventory Management System (JavaFX), branded "StockRoom".
    SampleData
    Sample stock for a small general store, added on the very first start.
    Sidebar
    Left navigation bar: the application wordmark, the navigation items and a footer area (used for the light/dark theme toggle).
    StatCard
    Small summary card showing one number, such as the count of low-stock items.
    StatusPillCell
    Table cell that shows a StockStatus as a small coloured pill.
    StockStatus
    Stock status of an inventory item.
    StorageException
    Thrown when inventory data cannot be read from or written to storage.
    ThemeToggle
    Button that switches the whole window between the light and dark theme.
    UiKit
    Small factory helpers shared by the user-interface classes.
    ValidationException
    Thrown when user input fails validation (empty name, invalid quantity, duplicate name).
